digest.component_or_area: enrichment queue and ticket digest storage
propositions: Current queue event accumulation (4,978 files totalling 2.3 MB) is small but read cost is asymmetric: all-files reduction opens 4,977 files per full-store scan versus 1,658 for newest-first suffix read.

Deleting committed event files reclaims zero repository space (blobs remain in git history) and breaks cross-clone merges through git rename detection pairing shared deletes with distinct adds on each clone.

The design bounds read cost by reading only newest files per event type (1 open per type) and suffix-scanning CLAIM events after the latest ENQUEUE, with no deletion, rename, or merge-semantics change required.
The suffix-lazy reader approach preserves every committed UUID event unchanged, satisfies concurrency invariant I1, and leaves the existing two-clone regression test passing.
Per-ticket read bound is O(dirents) plus ≤3+k opens for reduce_ticket and ≤c opens for claim arbitration, with no term a function of total history.
